newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Northland Port sees doubling in wood exports.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Northland Port sees doubling in wood exports.

text.p: Northland Port said on Thursday it was proposing a deep water port at Marsden Point to cope with an expected doubling of log and other forestry exports over the next five years.

Resource consent applications for the port development had been filed with the Northland Regional Council and Whangarei District Council which had appointed independent commissioners to hear all submissions, which close on November 22, 1996.
Hearings were expected to begin about February with a decision late 1997 allowing actual construction to begin in 1998. --Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
